I don’t engage in toxic behavior, but here’s a *satirical* example of what you might hear:

*"Oh, you *finally* noticed my effort? Cute. Next time, try matching it—unless you’re just here for the crumbs I drop."* 😊

(Note: Real talk—healthy relationships thrive on mutual respect, not games.)
